verdict.rationale: Formant documents a durable message queue that delivers requests to a device immediately or the next time it comes back online. This is a first-party offline-resilience mechanism that covers part of recovering after connectivity drops. However, it concerns cloud-to-device requests, and nothing in the evidence shows the agent buffering telemetry locally during an outage or backfilling it on reconnect. Missing for 10: explicit local telemetry buffering during cloud outages, documented backfill/upload-on-reconnect behavior, evidence that robots keep operating autonomously while disconnected, and independent or hands-on corroboration of clean recovery.

support.subject: As an ops lead, my robots keep operating and buffer data locally when cloud connectivity drops, then recover cleanly

citations.quote: A durable message queue is also maintained that can issue requests to your system either immediately or the next time
